mapper.sql: id, user_id, purpose, token_hash, expires_at, used_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_token (id, user_id, purpose, token_hash, expires_at, used_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{purpose}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{usedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM account_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND purpose = #{purpose}
mapper.update: UPDATE account_token SET used_at = #{usedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND used_at IS NULL
